authorityNote: Declares which capabilities are served by which MCP surfaces, so a capability can be resolved to the MCPs it depends on without reading a machine's realized config.
seedWarning: Intentionally unpopulated. A capability-to-MCP binding is a governance assertion; fabricating bindings from current tool inventories would make the same mistake this index exists to prevent — turning observed state into declared authority. Populate during ratification, one binding at a time, each with a stated basis.

populationPlan.basisRequired: Each binding must cite the capability's contract or the code path that calls the MCP.
